name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Spray PVA primer onto bare drywall ceiling, immediately backroll wet film to work primer into mud joints. Cut in the wall line with brush after the spray pass to clean up overspray on the masking tape. NC ceiling production standard.
doctrine: Spray ceiling primer (500 SF/hr baseline) is ~17% slower than spray wall primer because the sprayer is working overhead. Backroll (325 SF/hr baseline) handles filling into the texture profile. Cut-in after ceiling spray (100 LF/hr) is brush work against tape. Per-task texture sensitivity is author-set via the Modifier Editor UI — stomped/stippled ceilings may warrant flipping spray eligibility back on; standard new-construction drywall usually doesn't. The wall has been masked by MOD_SETUP_CEIL_MASK_ADJACENT before this module fires.
